invariant.portable_principle: A boundary proposal may recommend an extraction only when its public API, private reaches, caller impact, and verification plan are grounded in a complete static graph; incomplete or cohesive evidence must defer rather than invent a seam.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: Preserve the existing Python AST helper, scoring, and JSON behavior unchanged.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: A family-local Compiler API command resolves eligible static modules, top-level target symbols, and target-local call signatures through one named host tsconfig, then writes inspection JSON and final proposal Markdown.
explicit_non_goals: Source mutation, codemods, or refactor execution
Dynamic import, runtime loader, reflection, decorator, or external-consumer reachability
React, Node, ORM, route, dependency-injection, or other framework semantics
Safe deletion or framework-aware API ownership claims
A shared TypeScript parser, resolver, or fact platform

reference_repairs: No Python reference defect was found; tests pin the existing positive, cohesive, and excluded behavior without editing propose.py.
The TypeScript path treats unresolved static modules and compiler-reported ambiguous export stars as explicit defers, rather than copying Python's name-only graph assumptions.

syntax: static import, export-from, and import-equals module specifiers
type_system: A Program and TypeChecker resolve declaration symbols and call signatures.
Underscore-prefixed exported helpers are private by proposal convention, so external reaches are blockers rather than public API candidates.
module_resolution: The named tsconfig supplies compiler options, paths aliases, and project references.
resolveModuleName establishes relative and alias destinations.
Unresolved selected imports and diagnostic 2308 ambiguous export-star records make the graph partial and defer the proposal.
runtime: Node resolves TypeScript only from the target host package.json.
The locked fixture package-lock pins TypeScript 5.9.3.
framework: No framework assumption; TSX is accepted only as a source extension and no framework semantics are inferred.

tooling.selected: Family-local Node TypeScript Compiler API resolver in propose_typescript.mjs.

rejected_alternatives.lexical_import_and_call_scan: Cannot prove paths alias destinations, barrel destinations, or resolved call targets.
rejected_alternatives.ts_morph_or_tree_sitter: Adds dependencies without improving the accepted host-Compiler-API graph contract.
rejected_alternatives.shared_typescript_platform: map-subsystem has related resolution mechanics, but no second consumer has proven identical proposal facts, output, deferral, exclusions, and copied-install closure.

tooling.version_and_resolution: The fixture lock pins TypeScript 5.9.3. The installed runner requires package.json and resolves the package from that host inside project root.
tooling.closure_mode: Only the selected skill directory is copied. The documented command locates .agents or .claude and invokes the bundled Node runner without repository Python, scripts/_lib, _common, sibling skills, or a toolkit venv.
preflight_and_failure_codes: Exit 2 for missing target, direct symbolic-link target, missing/invalid tsconfig, missing host TypeScript, or target syntax error.
Emit defer_unresolved_graph for unresolved selected imports or ambiguous export symbols.
Emit defer_no_seam for a complete but cohesive one-domain target.

fresh_forward.task: Install only propose-boundary into a clean TypeScript host, request a boundary proposal for src/legacy, and inspect the final artifact without editing source.
fresh_forward.automated_installed_replay: Passed in the focused stock-install test using the exact documented command blocks and selected copied skill.

known_false_positives: Static module facts cannot prove external package consumers or runtime reachability.
Underscore privacy is an explicit TypeScript v1 proposal convention, not compiler-enforced encapsulation.
known_false_negatives: Dynamic imports, loaders, reflection, framework registries, decorators, and excluded/symlinked paths are intentionally unavailable.
Ambiguity detection is limited to compiler diagnostic 2308 export-star conflicts in selected target files.
legitimate_similar_shapes: A cohesive shipping target is a defer, not a fabricated split.
Direct, alias, and barrel importers are distinguished and listed instead of being collapsed into one caller count.
An unresolved or ambiguous graph still writes a reviewable proposal explaining why it deferred.

did_not_generalize: A shared Compiler API resolver module
Safe code movement or automated compatibility rewrites

evidence: map-subsystem and propose-boundary consume different facts and produce different output/deferral contracts.
No accepted second proposal consumer proves the same caller-impact and call-resolution requirements.

rust.native_tool: rust-analyzer or compiler-backed crate graph plus syn
rust.idiomatic_representation: pub items, use/re-export edges, mod/lib barrels, Cargo workspace members

go.idiomatic_representation: exported identifiers, package imports, internal packages, module replacements

java_or_kotlin.idiomatic_representation: public declarations, package imports, Gradle/Maven source sets

csharp.idiomatic_representation: public symbols, using/project references, solution boundaries

ruby.native_tool: Prism/Ripper plus an explicit loader convention
ruby.idiomatic_representation: public constants, require/re-export convention, gem boundaries

install_steps: Set PROPOSE_BOUNDARY_SOURCE to the pinned source/ref and run the documented selected-skill install command.
From the host root, use PROPOSE_TARGET, PROPOSE_TSCONFIG, and PROPOSE_NAME only when defaults do not fit, then run the documented proposal command.
Review proposal.md with inspection.json before authorizing a refactor.
agent_confusions: A resolved import graph is not a framework or runtime reachability graph.
A barrel must be named in compatibility planning, not mistaken for an implementation module.
An externally imported underscore helper is a migration blocker even if TypeScript permits the export.
repeated_work: The accepted map-subsystem pattern informed host-local resolution and stock closure, but no code was imported or shared.
user_experience.smallest_later_improvement: After a D6 replay and an independently accepted second boundary-style consumer, measure whether a shared resolver contract would actually remove repeated code without weakening its output guarantees.

residual_risks: D6 independent fresh-agent replay remains pending serial integration.
Dynamic/runtime/framework reachability and external consumers remain deliberately unavailable.
Hosts must provide Node, package.json, a host-local TypeScript package, and valid tsconfig.
Ambiguous export handling is intentionally narrow to selected diagnostic evidence.

next_decision.recommendation: Keep the resolver local and run the independent installed-host D6 replay before promotion.
next_decision.rationale: The positive final proposal, conservative defers, native fixture checks, and exact selected-skill stock replay prove a useful framework-neutral v1 without a platform expansion.
blockers: Serial integration of shared catalog/router/tracker claims outside this lane
